title: Lazar's file says humans are containers

tellings.quote: Freaks me out cuz then you go to like what Bob Lazar said that he was given in that file and he doesn't know if it's real or not.
That we're containers. That's how that's how supposedly the aliens look at us. That we are nothing but containers.
tellings.difference: Told first hand by Lazar, who adds that religion was created to protect the containers.
tellings.link_reason: Lazar tells first hand the same 'humans are containers' passage that telling 7 relays.

as_told.title: Lazar on the briefing document: humans are containers, religion created to protect them

tellings.quote: The in the initial briefing that he got, I'm not sure how much of that was true.
tellings.difference: Calls it the 'UFO Bible' briefing and does not mention the humans-as-containers claim.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the briefing file Lazar was given at S-4, and both doubt whether it was true.

as_told.title: Lazar's testimony and the briefing material he was given

plain: Briefing papers at S-4, a secret site in Nevada, said that aliens see humans as 'nothing but containers', according to Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft there in the late 1980s; he adds that religion was created to protect the containers, and says he does not know whether the papers were true. The guest Brigham Buhler repeats the claim on the same show, saying it frightens him, and the filmmaker Tim Alberino calls the papers Lazar's 'UFO Bible' briefing without the container claim, saying he is not sure how much of it was true.
